title: Old advancements
description: This mod adds some of the old advancements to the newer game
body:
This mod reintroduces several classic advancements from older Minecraft versions into the modern game.
It aims to bring back a bit of nostalgia while keeping everything fully compatible with the current advancement system.

All restored advancements are recreated as faithfully as possible, including their original names, icons, and trigger conditions. This allows players to experience that old-school progression feeling without sacrificing modern gameplay features.

However, some legacy advancements could not be added, as their original mechanics or triggers are not supported by MCreator’s current feature set. These have been left out to ensure stability and avoid unintended behavior.
